title: Infrastructure weekly update - 2026-05-04
body:
Summary:
- Short week due to ops heads-down on EU region maintenance. High-level: fleet healthy, we validated cross-region failover for private deployments, and moved forward on H100 procurement approval (finance signoff expected next week).

Fleet metrics (snapshot 2026-05-04):
- Total managed GPUs: 1,120 (mix: ~60% H100, 30% A100, 10% T4 for embeddings).
- Region breakdown: us-west-2: 640 GPUs (primary), eu-west-1: 280 GPUs (secondary), ap-southeast-1: 200 GPUs (spot/burst).
- Avg utilization (7d): 58% overall; p50 latency SLOs met. Peak observed this week: 84% (brief spike during internal benchmark run).
- Free capacity buffer: target 15% across regions; current buffer us-west-2=12% (slightly under), eu-west-1=22%, ap-southeast-1=18%.

Incidents and maintenance:
- 2026-05-01: eu-west maintenance window (planned): rolling kernel update + driver patch. Impact: 1.5h of degraded throughput for dedicated customers in eu-west; oncall runbook followed. Postmortem ticket: JIRA-INFRA-6198.
- 2026-05-03: transient autoscaler regression caused slower scale-up (PR 421 reverted briefly). Mitigations: reverted to stable autoscaler config, will ship a hardened rollout next Tuesday.

Capacity planning / procurement:
- Demand forecast: +28% q/q token throughput expected driven by two new enterprise customers (onboarding in Jun/Jul).
- Ask: Procurement to approve purchase of 200 additional H100s (target delivery window: Jul-Aug) to maintain 15% buffer in primary region. Finance has a draft capex approval; legal is finalizing contract terms.
- Short-term levers: enable pre-emptible burst in us-west (non-customer-isolated workloads), tighten per-team quotas for sandbox projects, and enable more aggressive KV cache reuse to reduce token load.

Region & routing updates:
- Completed cross-region failover smoke test for private deployments (canary group of 5 customers). Failover latency to eu->us route averaged 120ms extra, within SLA for canary. Notes: need to improve DNS TTL handling to shave ~30ms.
- Working on policy to route low-latency/latency-tolerant jobs to ap-southeast spot pool to reduce cost during regional peaks.

Ongoing projects / near-term roadmap:
- Autoscaler hardening (Priya): address scale-up step logic and add a safety mutex to prevent concurrent reconfig (ETA: 2026-05-12).
- Fleet telemetry revamp (Marco): add per-allocation GPU temp and power metrics to reduce noisy-neighbor incidents (ETA: 2026-05-18).
- Dedicated capacity UI change (Jordan + Console): expose per-customer reserve vs used metrics; design review complete, backend work in progress (ETA: 2026-05-25).

Blockers / help needed:
- Need procurement to expedite vendor terms for H100 order (Finance contact: Priya Nair).
- SRE needs additional 2 FTEs for oncall rotation to cover APAC region (raising as hiring req).
- DNS TTL change requires coordination with platform team; request engineering product for a scheduled maintenance window.

Action items for next week:
- Finalize procurement PO and confirm delivery windows (Evelyn / Priya).
- Ship autoscaler rollback-proof patch and run canary over 48h (Priya + oncall).
- Run full cross-region disaster recovery exercise for private cluster (Marco + SRE).
- Update cost model with APAC spot routing savings and present to finance (Jordan).

Notes / informal:
- "Notes to self": follow up with legal on supplier SLA clauses re: replacement timelines for faulty GPUs; vendor is pushing 8-10 weeks lead time but some SKUs show 12+ weeks.
- Remind teams to clean up long-running sandbox jobs - we observed several jobs consuming GPUs for >72h with low utilization. Will send a quota reminder email Monday.

If anything else needed for the exec brief, I can trim sections for the deck.
